ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - HandleKatz LSASS Dumper Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of HandleKatz, a tool that demonstrates the usage of cloned handles to Lsass in order to create an obfuscated memory dump of the same

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\loader\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-pid\\:.*")) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=38D9E015591BBFD4929E0D0F47FA0055.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0E2216679CA6E1094D63322E3412D650.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-pid\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-outfile\\:.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.obf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dump.*"))))
